title: SC07-T1 — the change (SH01, SH02, SH03a, SH03b)
line: I ordered my own before Rosa even left. And the first morning I tried it, the tired just lifted. For the first time in years, I did not look away from my own reflection.
motionPlan: Michelle walks to the vanity in her robe and sits on the stool, her own violet stick (a little longer than her hand is wide) on the vanity → her hand draws the stick (a little longer than her hand is wide) across her cheek, white going on → in the mirror Michelle meets her own eyes and holds them, her chin lifting a little → in the mirror Michelle meets her own eyes and holds them, her chin lifting a little
note: Waits for the plates, the cards and the voice masters to be confirmed, then one call (§24K part 5).
